title: Workbench import and export of official studio.markers.sidecar
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: This increment opens only a workbench import/export path for the official studio.markers.sidecar format already admitted in M.1. StudioWorkspace.importMarkers / exportMarkers and the Markers panel Import official marker sidecar / Export official marker sidecar controls use .studio-markers.json. Export writes every current project marker atomically. Import applies SetMarkers with the complete official store, restoring official ids and fields or refusing the whole file. Unknown extra fields stay MARKER_SIDECAR_UNSUPPORTED and are never stripped to invent success. A clipLocal host that is missing or no longer covering stays ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, never rewritten as absolute. Marker labels are not burned into preview or MP4, and this path is not an MP4 mux option.

A typo in docs/addenda/marker-sidecar-v1.md and docs/adr/m001-marker-sidecar-v1.md that wrote 喵喵 was corrected to 啾啾 (U+557E). That correction is not a new authorization. The M.1 commit 6cfe464ff2ae39dbf09d5eba614dd01a502be79d was not amended, and the frozen M.1 aggregate a0044aeebbb86ad04871d8c94fb5fa124566b2eb86dff5546d4920b9a74993e2 was not changed. The typo-corrected addendum and m001, plus ADR m002, are included in this increment's sourceSha256 / aggregateSha256.

A metadata workbench path adds two absolute markers, exports the official sidecar, deletes one marker, imports the file so both official objects return, then imports a file with an unknown field and shows MARKER_SIDECAR_UNSUPPORTED without changing the project. A persist-path SDK test covers the same APIs with a clipLocal marker present.

Already-delivered M.1 document-level sidecar contract, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, caption SRT/VTT workbench sidecars, and field-aware invert stay unchanged. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. WebVTT chapters, CSV, and FCPXML stay closed. I-005 and I-010 stay partial.
